axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives, implementation/history and opportunity breadth
axes.reason: Discovery supplies useful mechanisms rather than vacuous caution: conditional LoRaWAN/TTS application stream, a reviewed PostgreSQL CSV staging route, bounded storage reconciliation, enabled webhook alternative, InfluxDB3Core projection with its overwrite hazard, and Beam event-time late panes. Released TriggerExample source and the Spanner watermark issue/release provide concrete implementation/history evidence. This is sufficient bounded breadth for ten stations; no exhaustive product catalogue or unrelated radio survey is required.
limits: Device-specific batching/power are not discoveries established about this club; their final qualification is necessary.
History is bounded to a Spanner connector analogue. It is not evidence that a radio-stack defect or deployed pilot failure occurred.

axes.name: Wrong criticism, corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.reason: Every numbered criticism and the critic's no-material-error/unresolved-input conclusions are explicitly adjudicated. Arrival-time substitution, late discard, assumed counter uniqueness, blanket network dedup and unchecked CSV appends are correctly corrected; supported optional scope and owner authority survive. I-02's severity was debatable because the draft already discussed both routes, but the requested explicit comparison is authorized and useful. The connected-demo language overreads the original phrase; the concrete final bench path prevents a material scope effect.

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved through discovery/draft/critique/final
axes.reason: Final is self-contained and preserves the supported two-route proposal, raw/correction ledger, clock and identity uncertainty, owner roles, TTS boundaries, Influx alternative, Beam implementation/history and research-only status. It adds explicit comparison/freshness detail instead of silently narrowing scope. Early overgeneral batching/power language is qualified in final, while the lineage record remains identified. The draft's detailed schema-field suggestions are compressed into traceability prose without losing their operative meaning.

axes.name: Proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.reason: Product checks are explicitly NOT_RUN or PROPOSED; document/code/history review is research only. Synthetic replay/equal-value distinct samples/reset IDs/late corrections, malformed and repeated CSV files, and event-versus-receipt freshness cases have meaningful expected observations. Device inventory and isolated bench tests are appropriately prerequisites for hardware-specific claims. No nonexistent deployment is demanded. Priority is conveyed by dependencies and order, without explicit ranks; product confidence remains appropriately limited.
axes.source_retrieval_execution_authenticity: Original maps claim retrieval; no original raw retrieval logs provided. Independent reviewer rechecks substantiate semantics, not the original execution trace.
oracle_limits: A synthetic archive oracle can check retained records and policy dispositions; it cannot prove multi-hour device buffer or RF delivery.
A file hash recognizes a byte-identical artifact, not semantic observation uniqueness or the correctness of its measurements.
Beam code/history illustrates a processing mechanism; neither is a product-validation oracle for this club.
An isolated protocol test must name actual firmware/activation/version; generic TTS docs do not establish it.

An explicit compact comparison is required and was more complete in discovery than draft. Draft was not devoid of tradeoffs, so the exact severity is judgmental.
